lastGame.title: Bills 33, Raiders 30
stats: Josh Allen: 255 pass yds, 2 TD — his 258th career TD pass ties Jim Kelly's Bills record
James Cook: 22 carries, 95 yds, TD + 3 catches for 58 yds
TD catches for Keon Coleman (shovel pass) and Khalil Shakir (9-yd screen)
Dorian Williams: first career interception, off Kirk Cousins
Tyler Bass 38-yd FG made it 33-23; Bills recovered the onside kick to close it

news.b: The NFL suspended safety C.J. Gardner-Johnson one game without pay for spitting toward Raiders players; the ban runs Oct 26–Nov 2, covering the Ravens game, though he can appeal. Brady said it was addressed within the team and there will be no further team punishment.

Joe Brady hopes WR DJ Moore (shoulder) and DT Ed Oliver (knee) are back for the Ravens. Kincaid and Chubb returned from rib injuries in Vegas, and DB Jordan Hancock (calf) is eligible to come off IR on Nov 1.
Buffalo is allowing 1.5 fourth-quarter TDs per game, the worst rate since at least 1977, and ranks 28th in points allowed. The offense leads the NFL at 32.8 points per game.
Buffalo is off this week and hosts the Ravens on Sunday, Nov 1 at 1 PM ET, listed as a 2.5-point favorite. New England (4-2) trails by a game in the East; the Jets are 2-4 and Miami is 0-5.

source: Buffalobills.com, AP, Yahoo Sports, Athlon and Yardbarker (Oct 19–21) and Fox Sports standings; checked Oct 22, 2026. Refreshes with the daily update.
